climate: A dry climate, and what little rain there is falls mostly in summer. Water is scarce.
Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A southwestern New Mexico AVA along the Mimbres River, around Deming, between Silver City and Columbus. Most vineyards lie at 4,000 to 6,000 feet, with the Mogollon Mountains to the north. It was New Mexico's second AVA.
